# LED spectrum firmware, vendored excerpt

`baseline.cpp` is lines 195 to 211 of `Spectrum Analyzer Code (LEA).txt` from https://github.com/avemath/led-audio-spectrum at commit `a21c77d`, copied unmodified. It is the adaptive noise baseline the home page LED spotlight shows. Only this part is vendored; the rest of the firmware is ported in `src/lib/led-firmware.ts`. Update the line numbers in `src/components/live/LedLive.astro` if the repo changes.
